request.description:
Look up securities by various identifiers including symbol, exchange code, ISIN, FIGI, LEI, CUSIP, and CIK.

**At least one of the following filter parameters is required**:
`filter[symbol]`, `filter[isin]`, `filter[figi]`, `filter[lei]`, `filter[cusip]`, `filter[cik]`, or `filter[ex]`.
A request without any of these will return HTTP 422.

item.name: Get exchange details and trading hours (v2)

variable.description: (Required) Exchange code (case-insensitive). Use /v2/exchange-details to get the list of supported codes.

request.description: Returns trading hours, extended sessions (pre-market, after-hours), lunch breaks, and the full holiday calendar for the requested exchange. Covers 73 exchanges with verified data. The code parameter is case-insensitive.

response.name: Successful response with exchange details, trading hours, and holiday calendar.
Unauthorized — missing or invalid API token.

request.description: Returns an array of all exchange codes supported by the v2 endpoint. Use these codes to request details for a specific exchange via /v2/exchange-details/{code}.

response.name: Successful response with list of exchange codes.
